description: United Republic of Tanzania - Alternative Cooking Fuels and Training Programme - 2019 is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by UNHCR - The UN Refugee Agency. At present over 90% of households across all three refugee camps in the Kigoma Region of Tanzania use firewood for cooking, which is being collected from the forests within, and around, the refugee camps leading to deforestation. Coverage: Tanzania. The portal files it under the publisher UNHCR - The UN Refugee Agency. Its tags are environment, facilities-infrastructure. It offers 2 resource(s) in PDF, WEB APP. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
